en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a cobblestone street with pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. In the background is a large multi‑storey building complex with a steep tiled roof and many chimneys, identified as a castle or palace. Trees and a low wall with gate pillars line the street. On the right edge stands a substantial building facade. The caption at the bottom reads in German, indicating the view is of Hofgasse street with the castle in Graz.
